cards.card_text: Then Job says God puts his feet in the stocks and stands watch over all his paths.
cards.verse_text: You put my feet in the stocks and stand watch over all my paths; You set a limit for the soles of my feet.

cards.card_text: Elihu quotes Job one more time: "He puts my feet in the stocks; He watches over all my paths." He's reading Job's own words back to him, like a friend who screenshots your text and pulls it out mid-argument.
cards.verse_text: He puts my feet in the stocks; He watches over all my paths.’

cards.card_text: Shemaiah tells Zephaniah that a madman who acts like a prophet must be put in stocks and neck irons.
cards.verse_text: ‘The LORD has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada, to be the chief officer in the house of the LORD, responsible for any madman who acts like a prophet—you must put him in stocks and neck irons.
cards.snippet: …for any madman who acts like a prophet—you must put him in stocks and neck irons.

cards.verse_text: On receiving this order, he placed them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.
